homepage.whyChooseSubheading: WORLD-CLASS CLINICAL EXCELLENCE WITH A GENTLE, PERSONAL TOUCH

whyChooseItems.title: Advanced Embryology Lab
whyChooseItems.description: Equipped with HEPA-filtered cleanrooms, benchtop tri-gas incubators, and cutting-edge micromanipulators for optimal embryo cultivation.

whyChooseItems.title: Individualized Clinical Protocols
whyChooseItems.description: Tailored stimulation protocols designed around your age, ovarian reserve (AMH), and past treatment history to maximize healthy blastocysts.

whyChooseItems.title: Compassionate Mind-Body Support
whyChooseItems.description: Dedicated fertility counselors and clinical psychologists provide continuous emotional guidance through every stage of your cycle.

whyChooseItems.title: Transparent Pricing & EMI Options
whyChooseItems.description: Clear, ethical estimates from day one with 0% interest monthly installment assistance so financial stress never stands in your way.

homepage.treatmentProcessSubheading: TRANSPARENT, EVIDENCE-BASED FERTILITY CARE AT EVERY STEP

treatmentProcessSteps.title: Initial Consultation & Diagnostic Mapping
treatmentProcessSteps.description: Comprehensive pelvic scan, semen analysis, and hormonal evaluation to pinpoint underlying reproductive factors.

treatmentProcessSteps.title: Personalized Stimulation & Follicular Monitoring
treatmentProcessSteps.description: Carefully titrated gonadotropin stimulation monitored via regular ultrasound and E2 levels to produce quality mature oocytes.

treatmentProcessSteps.title: Ovum Pick-Up & Cleanroom Embryo Culture
treatmentProcessSteps.description: Painless egg retrieval followed by advanced ICSI and incubation in tri-gas micro-incubators to Day 5 blastocyst stage.

treatmentProcessSteps.title: Gentle Embryo Transfer & Post-Care
treatmentProcessSteps.description: Ultrasound-guided transfer of the top-grade embryo into the prepared endometrium, followed by dedicated luteal phase support.

doctors.name: Dr. Radhika Sharma
doctors.qualification: MBBS, MS (OBGYN), Fellowship in Reproductive Medicine (Germany), FICOG
doctors.shortBio: Leading reproductive endocrinologist with over 18 years of clinical expertise in complex IVF cases and recurrent implantation failure.
doctors.fullBio: Dr. Radhika Sharma is the Medical Director at Prisha IVF. Having trained extensively in Germany and premier Indian medical institutions, she is widely recognized for her patient-centric protocols and exceptional success rates in patients with diminished ovarian reserve and advanced maternal age.

doctors.name: Dr. Ananya Sen
doctors.qualification: M.Sc, Ph.D. in Clinical Embryology (UK), Senior Embryologist (ESHRE Certified)
doctors.shortBio: Internationally certified senior embryologist overseeing laboratory protocols, micro-manipulation, and high-survival vitrification.
doctors.fullBio: Dr. Ananya Sen heads the embryology laboratories at Prisha IVF. A certified member of the European Society of Human Reproduction and Embryology (ESHRE), she brings unmatched precision to micromanipulation and laser-assisted hatching.

doctors.name: Dr. Vikramaditya Rathore
doctors.qualification: MBBS, MS, MCh (Urology & Andrology), Fellowship in Male Reproductive Microsurgery
doctors.shortBio: Distinguished andrologist dedicated to advanced surgical sperm retrieval (Micro-TESE) and comprehensive male fertility treatments.
doctors.fullBio: Dr. Vikramaditya Rathore is a specialized male fertility microsurgeon with deep expertise in non-obstructive azoospermia and severe male factor infertility.

doctors.name: Dr. Meenakshi Joshi
doctors.designation: Consultant Reproductive Medicine & High-Risk Pregnancy Care
doctors.qualification: MBBS, DNB (OBGYN), Fellowship in Infertility & Ultrasound (IMA-AMS)
doctors.shortBio: Compassionate fertility clinician specializing in polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS), recurrent pregnancy loss, and personalized lifestyle medicine.
doctors.fullBio: Dr. Meenakshi Joshi works closely with couples facing unexplained infertility and PCOS. She blends medical ovulation induction with nutritional balancing and psychological readiness.

doctors.name: Dr. Rajiv Oberoi
doctors.qualification: MBBS, MS, FMAS, Fellowship in Advanced Pelvic Endoscopy (France)
doctors.shortBio: Pioneering gynecological endoscopic surgeon correcting uterine anomalies, severe pelvic adhesions, and blocked fallopian tubes.
doctors.fullBio: Dr. Rajiv Oberoi ensures the uterine environment is anatomically optimized prior to embryo transfer using ultra-high-definition 4K hysteroscopy.

doctors.name: Dr. Priya Narang
doctors.qualification: M.Sc (Biotechnology), PG Diploma in Reproductive Genetics & Counseling
doctors.shortBio: Expert in pre-implantation genetic counseling, assisting couples with hereditary chromosomal and single-gene disorder risks.
doctors.fullBio: Dr. Priya Narang conducts Day-5 trophectoderm biopsies and interprets comprehensive Next-Generation Sequencing genetic data.
